# Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit below this line.

`fit` and `fdescribe` are short names for `it.only` and `describe.only`. `xit`, `xtest` and `xdescribe` are short names for `it.skip`, `test.skip` and `describe.skip`. One extra letter is easy to miss in a review, and a search for `.only` or `.skip` doesn't find it.

`--fix` rewrites the short name to the long one. It doesn't change your imports. It leaves a call alone if a variable around it has the long name.

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. To turn it on:

```toml bunfig.toml
[lint.rules]
"jest/no-test-prefixes" = "error" # or "warn"
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad {"count": 3} */}
```ts
import { expect, fit, xdescribe, xtest } from "@jest/globals";

fit("adds", () => {
  expect(1 + 1).toBe(2);
});

xtest("subtracts", () => {
  expect(3 - 1).toBe(2);
});

xdescribe("division", () => {});
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}
```ts
import { describe, expect, it, test } from "@jest/globals";

it.only("adds", () => {
  expect(1 + 1).toBe(2);
});

test.skip("subtracts", () => {
  expect(3 - 1).toBe(2);
});

describe.skip("division", () => {});
```

`xit.each` is reported too, and `--fix` turns it into `it.skip.each`:

{/* bad */}
```ts
import { expect, xit } from "@jest/globals";

xit.each([1, 2, 3])("%i is positive", n => {
  expect(n).toBeGreaterThan(0);
});
```
